# Dropdown

**Class:** `UltraCanvasDropdown` · **Group:** [Buttons and choices](../Groups/Buttons-and-choices.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasDropdown.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasDropdown.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasDropdown.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Pick one of a list (a row can be drawn in a font of its own: a font list, `DropdownItem::fontFamily`)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasDropdown> CreateDropdown( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h = 24);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasDropdown(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasDropdown(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasDropdown(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(int, const DropdownItem&)> onSelectionChanged` | _Selection changed_ |
| `onItemHovered` | `std::function<void(int, const DropdownItem&)> onItemHovered` | _Item hovered_ |
| `onDropdownOpened` | `std::function<void()> onDropdownOpened` | _Dropdown opened_ |
| `onDropdownClosed` | `std::function<void()> onDropdownClosed` | _Dropdown closed_ |
| `onKeyDown` | `std::function<bool(const UCEvent&)> onKeyDown` | _Key down_ |
| `onMultiSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<int>&)> onMultiSelectionChanged` | _Multi selection changed_ |
| `onSelectedItemsChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<DropdownItem>&)> onSelectedItemsChanged` | _Selected items changed_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
